title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
author: Marc Peter Deisenroth, A. Aldo Faisal, Cheng Soon Ong
description: The mathematical foundations behind machine learning, taught for ML rather than in the abstract: linear algebra, analytic geometry, matrix decompositions, vector calculus, probability, and optimization, connected to real ML models.
